paragraphs.source_en: Like a giant oak tree covered with apple blossoms is the vast man in you. His might binds you to the earth, his fragrance lifts you into space, and in his durability you are deathless.

units.source_en: Like a giant oak tree covered with apple blossoms is the vast man in you.
His might binds you to the earth, his fragrance lifts you into space, and in his durability you are deathless.

ja.t: のうちにあなたがたは

paragraphs.source_en: You have been told that, even like a chain, you are as weak as your weakest link.

units.source_en: You have been told that, even like a chain, you are as weak as your weakest link.

paragraphs.source_en: To measure you by your smallest deed is to reckon the power of ocean by the frailty of its foam.

units.source_en: To measure you by your smallest deed is to reckon the power of ocean by the frailty of its foam.

paragraphs.source_en: To judge you by your failures is to cast blame upon the seasons for their inconstancy.

units.source_en: To judge you by your failures is to cast blame upon the seasons for their inconstancy.

paragraphs.source_en: And though heavy-grounded ships await the tide upon your shores, yet, even like an ocean, you cannot hasten your tides.

units.source_en: And though heavy-grounded ships await the tide upon your shores, yet, even like an ocean, you cannot hasten your tides.

ja.t: っていても、あなたがたは
めることはできません。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet spring, reposing within you, smiles in her drowsiness and is not offended. Think not I say these things in order that you may say the one to the other, “He praised us well. He saw but the good in us.”

units.source_en: Yet spring, reposing within you, smiles in her drowsiness and is not offended.

ja.t: てることはありません。

units.source_en: Think not I say these things in order that you may say the one to the other, “He praised us well.
He saw but the good in us.”

paragraphs.source_en: Your thoughts and my words are waves from a sealed memory that keeps records of our yesterdays,

units.source_en: Your thoughts and my words are waves from a sealed memory that keeps records of our yesterdays,

paragraphs.source_en: Wise men have come to you to give you of their wisdom. I came to take of your wisdom:

units.source_en: Wise men have come to you to give you of their wisdom.

ja.t: たちはあなたがたのもとへ

units.source_en: I came to take of your wisdom:

paragraphs.source_en: While you, heedless of its expansion, bewail the withering of your days. It is life in quest of life in bodies that fear the grave.

units.source_en: While you, heedless of its expansion, bewail the withering of your days.

ja.t: づかないまま、あなたがたは
々がしおれてゆくことを

units.source_en: It is life in quest of life in bodies that fear the grave.

paragraphs.source_en: Whenever you pass by the field where you have laid your ancestors look well thereupon, and you shall see yourselves and your children dancing hand in hand.

units.source_en: Whenever you pass by the field where you have laid your ancestors look well thereupon, and you shall see yourselves and your children dancing hand in hand.

つめなさい。そうすれば、あなたがた

paragraphs.source_en: Others have come to you to whom for golden promises made unto your faith you have given but riches and power and glory.

units.source_en: Others have come to you to whom for golden promises made unto your faith you have given but riches and power and glory.

ja.t: 々もあなたがたのもとに

paragraphs.source_en: Surely there is no greater gift to a man than that which turns all his aims into parching lips and all life into a fountain.

units.source_en: Surely there is no greater gift to a man than that which turns all his aims into parching lips and all life into a fountain.
